selected.question: How do scientists know so much about the deep ocean when we've explored so little of it?
selected.pov_line: 'Scientists say' is almost meaningless on its own. Which scientists? How many? Was it one paper? Was it replicated?

selected.question: How do scientists know how old something is?
selected.pov_line: I'm not anti-science. I'm against using science as a magic authority word that means nobody has to show their work.

selected.question: How do scientists know about other galaxies?
selected.pov_line: Science is a process. It is not a person behind a curtain handing down permanent answers.

selected.question: why deep sea fish die when brought to surface
selected.pov_line: When I picture the deep ocean I don't see blue water or fish. I see black. A massive amount of black space where you can't tell what's beside you or beneath you.
